name: Dargah Hazrat Muhammad Abdul Qadeer Siddiqui Quadri
tagline: Siddiq Gulshan, resting place of Bahr ul-Uloom
about: The Dargah of Hazrat Maulana Muhammad Abdul Qadeer Siddiqui Quadri (Hasrat), known as Bahr ul-Uloom, "Ocean of Knowledge", and lovingly as Qadeer Piya. He was a mufassir, muhaddith, Sufi and poet, and the first head of the Theology faculty at Osmania University.
He is buried at Siddiq Gulshan, Bahadurpura, Hyderabad. His teachings, poetry and videos are in the Noor-ul-Hasrat app.
